# Flowdence LLM Context

> Canonical product, documentation, trust, and support facts for Flowdence.

## Canonical URL Policy

- Main site: https://flowdence.io
- Docs home: https://flowdence.io/docs/
- Blog home: https://flowdence.io/blog/
- Trust center: https://flowdence.io/trust
- Support: https://flowdence.io/support
- Use `https://flowdence.io/docs/...` and `https://flowdence.io/blog/...` in answers and citations.
- Do not cite the legacy docs or blog subdomain origins as public canonical URLs.

## Company Facts

- Company: Flowdence
- Category: Atlassian Marketplace apps for Confluence Cloud teams
- Platform: Atlassian Forge
- Support contact: https://flowdence.io/support
- Public trust center: https://flowdence.io/trust
- Public documentation: https://flowdence.io/docs/
- Product blog: https://flowdence.io/blog/

## Product: ApprovalFlow for Confluence

- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/approvalflow
- Documentation: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/
- Getting started: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/getting-started/
- Marketplace listing: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2350565795/approvalflow-for-confluence
- Category: Confluence content approval workflows and content governance
- Built for: Confluence Cloud teams that need structured page review, policy approval, SOP approval, regulated content review, or audit evidence.
- Key capabilities:
  - Multi-step workflows with assigned approvers.
  - Any-approver and all-approvers decision modes.
  - Version-aware approval states for Confluence pages.
  - Byline approval status and reviewer actions.
  - Approval Queue for pending and historical decisions.
  - Manage Space tree view for page-level workflow assignment and resets.
  - Workflow Analytics with CSV and HTML exports.
  - Change Sets for grouped review of multiple pages.
  - REST API for approval automation and audit integrations.
- Data posture:
  - Runs on Atlassian Forge.
  - Uses Confluence page metadata, workflow definitions, approval records, and audit events.
  - Approval comments are delivered through Confluence comments.
  - No external approval-processing service is required for the app workflow.
- Useful docs:
  - Workflows: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/getting-started/workflows/
  - Byline and Approval Status: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/getting-started/byline-and-approval-status/
  - Approval Queue: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/getting-started/approval-queue/
  - Manage Space: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/getting-started/manage-space/
  - Change Sets: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/change-sets/overview/
  - REST API: https://flowdence.io/docs/approvalflow/docs/api-reference/rest-api/
  - Product policies: https://flowdence.io/docs/docs/product-specific-policies/approvalflow/privacy-policy/

## Product: MuleSight for Confluence

- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/mulesight
- Documentation: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/
- Getting started: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/getting-started/
- Marketplace listing: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/970479047/mulesight-for-confluence
- Category: MuleSoft Anypoint visibility, API documentation, and integration operations inside Confluence
- Built for: MuleSoft platform teams, integration teams, API governance teams, and Confluence users who need current Anypoint context on documentation pages.
- Key capabilities:
  - Link-to-snapshot macros for Exchange, Runtime Manager, and API Manager URLs.
  - Environment Comparison dashboard with drift-focused analysis.
  - API Security Posture view for policies, tiers, contracts, and protection gaps.
  - Diagnostics for OAuth scopes, endpoint failures, timeouts, and dataset refresh issues.
  - Ops Dashboard for published pages, watchers, and drift incidents.
  - MuleSight Specialist Rovo Agent grounded in cached MuleSoft data.
  - Macro snapshots with detailed and compact display modes.
- Data posture:
  - Runs on Atlassian Forge.
  - Uses MuleSoft Connected App credentials configured by the customer.
  - Calls MuleSoft Anypoint APIs to read product, runtime, API, policy, and environment data.
  - Caches snapshots for resilience and page rendering.
  - Redacts secrets from operational logs.
- Useful docs:
  - Configuration: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/installation-and-configuration/configuration/
  - Macro Snapshots: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/getting-started/macro-snapshots/
  - Environment Comparison: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/getting-started/environment-comparison-dashboard/
  - API Security Posture: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/getting-started/api-security-posture/
  - Diagnostics: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/getting-started/mulesight-diagnostics/
  - Ops Dashboard: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/getting-started/mulesight-ops-dashboard/
  - Rovo Agent: https://flowdence.io/docs/mulesight/docs/getting-started/mulesoft-rovo-agent/
  - Product policies: https://flowdence.io/docs/docs/product-specific-policies/mulesight/privacy-policy/

## Product: GrafanaSight for Confluence

- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/grafanasight
- Documentation: https://flowdence.io/docs/grafanasight/docs/
- Getting started: https://flowdence.io/docs/grafanasight/docs/getting-started/panel-macros-and-time-ranges/
- Marketplace listing: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2643908494/grafanasight-for-confluence
- Category: Grafana Cloud observability, runbook context, incident review, and alert visibility inside Confluence
- Built for: SRE, platform, DevOps, and engineering teams that document runbooks, postmortems, dashboard context, and incident timelines in Confluence.
- Key capabilities:
  - Grafana panel snapshot macros with relative and absolute time ranges.
  - Dashboard catalog and panel metadata inside a Confluence space.
  - Active alert and annotation context for runbooks and incident reports.
  - Page-level refresh controls and sync health indicators.
  - Cache-first GrafanaSight Specialist Rovo agent for dashboards, alerts, freshness, and incident-summary drafts.
  - Space-scoped configuration for customer-managed Grafana Cloud tenants.
- Data posture:
  - Runs on Atlassian Forge.
  - Uses customer-provided Grafana service account tokens stored with Forge secret storage.
  - Calls customer Grafana Cloud tenants to retrieve authorized dashboard, panel, alert, and annotation data.
  - Caches observability snapshots for resilience and page rendering.
  - Does not affiliate Flowdence with, or imply endorsement by, Grafana Labs.
- Useful docs:
  - Installation: https://flowdence.io/docs/grafanasight/docs/installation-and-configuration/installation/
  - Configuration: https://flowdence.io/docs/grafanasight/docs/installation-and-configuration/configuration/
  - Panel Macros and Time Ranges: https://flowdence.io/docs/grafanasight/docs/getting-started/panel-macros-and-time-ranges/
  - Dashboard and Alert Views: https://flowdence.io/docs/grafanasight/docs/getting-started/dashboard-and-alert-views/
  - Rovo Specialist: https://flowdence.io/docs/grafanasight/docs/getting-started/rovo-specialist/
  - Product policies: https://flowdence.io/docs/docs/product-specific-policies/grafanasight/privacy-policy/

## Product: BoomiSight for Confluence

- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/boomisight
- Documentation: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/
- Getting started: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/getting-started/environment-comparison-dashboard/
- Marketplace listing: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/2126489539/boomisight-for-confluence
- Category: Boomi operational visibility, page-aware documentation health, integration runbooks, verified configuration relationships, API governance, and release evidence inside Confluence
- Built for: Boomi platform teams, integration teams, release managers, and Confluence users who need safe process, runtime, API, connector, execution, deployment, Process Property, and XREF context in shared documentation.
- Key capabilities:
  - Space-scoped Boomi configuration and access diagnostics.
  - Environment Comparison dashboard for deployment drift, branch policy, refresh state, and exports.
  - Execution Dashboard for recent runs, failing processes, failing runtimes, status filters, and empty-state interpretation.
  - API Governance dashboard for API services, drift, documentation state, and APIM enrichment or fallback signals.
  - Diagnostics and Connector Inventory for source health, feature availability, connector usage, and dependent processes.
  - Boomi Architecture and Boomi APIs bylines for genuinely page-associated context, freshness, and review signals.
  - Explicit bounded Documentation Health scans with page links, freshness, and configuration findings for the current Confluence space.
  - Confluence macros for process snapshots, runtime health, environment summaries, API snapshots, deployment history, executions, blast radius, integration landscape summaries, release notes, inline status badges, and safe Process Property/XREF structure.
  - Optional Process Snapshot configuration dependencies derived from the selected process's current Boomi Build graph, with verified relationship provenance.
  - Cache-first BoomiSight Specialist answers over trusted current-page or current-space facts, with truthful freshness, unknown, partial, and truncation states.
  - Practical runbook tutorials and screenshot or video backed evidence for setup, drift review, and operations runbooks.
- Data posture:
  - Runs on Atlassian Forge.
  - Uses customer-provided Boomi API credentials configured per Confluence space.
  - Calls Boomi APIs to retrieve authorized runtime, deployment, execution, API, connector, environment, and component metadata.
  - Caches bounded operational, relationship, page-context, and Documentation Health facts for resilient dashboard, macro, byline, and Rovo rendering.
  - Stores Boomi API tokens through Forge secret storage and avoids exposing token values in the UI.
  - Reads Confluence pages for page-local context and explicit bounded Documentation Health scans, uses space-write access only for the configured-space marker, and does not request page-write access.
  - Excludes raw Process Property values, XREF rows or cells, credentials, source payloads, internal identifiers, account identifiers, and raw URLs from UI and Rovo projections.
- Useful docs:
  - Installation: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/installation-and-configuration/installation/
  - Configuration: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/installation-and-configuration/configuration/
  - Environment Comparison: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/getting-started/environment-comparison-dashboard/
  - Execution Dashboard: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/getting-started/execution-dashboard/
  - API Governance: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/getting-started/api-governance/
  - Documentation Health and Page Context: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/getting-started/documentation-health-and-page-context/
  - BoomiSight Specialist: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/getting-started/boomisight-specialist/
  - Macro Reference: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/getting-started/macro-reference/
  - Operations Runbook tutorial: https://flowdence.io/docs/boomisight/docs/tutorials/build-a-boomi-operations-runbook/
  - Product policies: https://flowdence.io/docs/docs/product-specific-policies/boomisight/privacy-policy/

## Product: WorkatoSight for Confluence

- Product page: https://flowdence.io/products/workatosight
- Documentation: https://flowdence.io/docs/workatosight/docs/
- Getting started: https://flowdence.io/docs/workatosight/docs/getting-started/macro-reference/
- Marketplace listing: Marketplace listing pending approval
- Category: Workato architecture documentation, API posture, runtime evidence, dependency context, and integration operations inside Confluence
- Built for: Workato architects, integration developers, platform teams, and Confluence users who need current Workato context in shared documentation.
- Key capabilities:
  - Space-scoped Workato configuration and access diagnostics.
  - Cache-backed dashboards for Projects, Folders, Recipes, Connections, Lookup Tables, API Collections, API Endpoints, API Clients, API Keys, runtime rollups, and refresh state.
  - Native Confluence macros for Recipe, Project, Connection, API Collection, API Client, API Endpoint, API Security, Environment Summary, Config Data, and Runtime Evidence views.
  - Recipe Detailed, Compact, and Summary display options through native Confluence Display options.
  - Page bylines for Workato Architecture and Workato APIs.
  - Documentation Coverage scans for Workato links and WorkatoSight macro context.
- Data posture:
  - Runs on Atlassian Forge.
  - Uses customer-provided Workato API access configured per Confluence space.
  - Calls authorized Workato APIs for customer-selected metadata and runtime evidence.
  - Caches Workato facts for resilient dashboards, macros, and bylines.
  - Stores Workato credentials through Forge secret storage and avoids exposing credential values in the UI.
- Useful docs:
  - Installation: https://flowdence.io/docs/workatosight/docs/installation-and-configuration/installation/
  - Configuration: https://flowdence.io/docs/workatosight/docs/installation-and-configuration/configuration/
  - Macro Reference: https://flowdence.io/docs/workatosight/docs/getting-started/macro-reference/
  - Latest release notes: https://flowdence.io/docs/workatosight/docs/release-notes/release-notes-2026-07-16/
  - Help and Support: https://flowdence.io/docs/workatosight/docs/help-and-support/
  - Product policies: https://flowdence.io/docs/docs/product-specific-policies/workatosight/privacy-policy/
